title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Use cross-platform report layout paths (forward slashes or backslashes)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 (BC29) allows report layout and analysis view paths to use either forward or backward slashes consistently across Windows and Linux systems. This enables the same AL source code to compile identically on different operating systems without requiring path changes.
key_points: Report layout properties (RDLCLayout, WordLayout, ExcelLayout, LayoutFile, DefinitionFile) now accept both / and \ separators on all operating systems
Same AL source code compiles identically on Windows and Linux without path modifications
AL0363 diagnostic is no longer reported for mismatched directory separators
Particularly useful for cross-platform development and CI/CD pipelines using different build environments
